text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains in a mixed market where altcoins show divergent momentum—SOL up 1.8% while BNB slides. The Fear & Greed index at 41 reflects underlying caution, though the 12-point weekly jump suggests some tentative recovery in appetite. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 56.6% paired with moderate volume of $47B indicates traders are rotating defensively into the larger, safer assets rather than chasing broader risk.
